call_points.text: Overall growth target of 10-15% over next two to three years, described as a big achievement given global uncertainty.
Company preparing feed price increase, expects to finalise quantum in one week to ten days.
No major capex foreseen in the next two years for feed or processing.
Avanti Frozen Foods expects USD 15-20 million in US tariff refunds; process suspended pending anti-dumping reviews.
Management unable to prepare FY27 budget yet due to uncertainty over raw material costs and global situation.

Overall growth target of 10-15% over next two to three years.
Shrimp exports during FY27 estimated around 19,000 MT.

industry: Fast Moving Consumer Goods > Food Products > Animal Feed

operating_notes.text: Board recommended final dividend of ₹10 per share (face value ₹1) for FY26.
Fish meal price doubled from ₹100 to ₹240 per kg in two months; soya bean meal up about 45%.
Pet care sales reached ₹151 lakh in Q4FY26, with 31 distributors across 13 cities.
Shrimp processing capacity is 26,000-28,000 MT but highly seasonal.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,467.72 Cr (+6.0% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹125.11 Cr.
Avanti Feeds Limited’s Board recommended a **final dividend of ₹10 per share** (FY2026) for AGM approval.
On 12 June 2026, Avanti Feeds held its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding FY27 feed sales to 5,80,000 MT and flagging steep raw material cost inflation.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for final dividend of ₹10 per share at AGM
Shareholder approval for re-appointment of Dr. A. Indra Kumar as Chairman & MD

watchlist.response: Management deflected, asking the analyst to send an email instead of providing the figure.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked for effective capacity utilisation of 26,000-28,000 MT shrimp processing capacity.

watchlist.response: Management said business must be built step by step due to quality and food safety requirements.
watchlist.text: Analyst pressed on why growth is only 10-15% despite FTA benefits and peer comparison.
